_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Axis Bank Shoppers Stop Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: Axis product page (read 2026-11-07), Value Chart footnote: "The Redemption Value of Each FC Point = Rs. 0.50". The Value Chart rows agree with it (₹1,50,000 of other spend at 2 FC per ₹200 = 1,500 FC shown as ₹750; ₹50,000 on exclusive brands at 20 FC per ₹200 = 5,000 FC shown as ₹2,500; welcome FC "worth Rs. 300"). The member T&C does not state a per-point value. FC points redeem only at Shoppers Stop, Homestop, Arcelia, MAC, Clinique, Estee Lauder, Bobbi Brown, Jo Malone and Smashbox (T&C 6); Shoppers Stop can change its programme terms.

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Annual fee waived at ₹1 lakh spend in the anniversary year; rent and wallet MCCs excluded from the spend (T&C 3; MITC says waived on spends of ₹1,00,000 in the preceding year; the issuer page says "Waived for cumulative spend of Rs. 1 L and above"). The T&C ties the waiver to cardholders issued on or after 1 May 2024 and onboarded through the Axis platform.

welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: First Citizen points worth ₹300 after the first transaction within 30 days of issue (issuer page: points worth ₹300; vouchers worth ₹2,250), plus 3 Shoppers Stop vouchers of ₹500 (each needs a ₹5,000 purchase), 1 voucher of ₹500 (needs ₹2,500 on exclusive brands, apparel) and a Shoppers Stop online voucher saving ₹250 on shoppersstop.com (₹1,500 + ₹500 + ₹250 = ₹2,250), plus a complimentary Golden Glow membership. In-store vouchers expire 2 months after issue and are not valid on shoppersstop.com; welcome benefits are for cardholders issued on or after 1 May 2024 through the Axis platform and not for customers swapped or migrated before 31 Jul 2024 (T&C 4 and Annexure 1).

open_questions: Network: Visa Platinum, read from the card art on the issuer page banner (Visa logo with "Platinum" under it, Shoppers Stop mark; the banner is the live one on the page, 7 Nov 2026). Second source looked for and not found: the Axis all-credit-cards listing thumbnail for this card carries no network mark; the member T&C only says "Merchant Category Codes (MCC) as allotted by Mastercard & Visa"; the page text and the Axis Citi-migration page do not name a network; Axis's Citi-Axis migration FAQ PDF (axisbank.com .../download-faq/faq_credit_card.pdf) was refused with 403 and was not pursued. Card art on the issuer's own product page is accepted network evidence, so network is set to Visa with tier Visa Platinum; a person holding an issued card can confirm.
Renewal fee: the MITC row shows ₹500 with a ₹1,00,000 waiver; the T&C bills the annual fee at the first statement date after the anniversary year. Both agree on ₹500.

First Citizen point value is ₹0.50 per the issuer page Value Chart footnote only; the member T&C states no per-point value, and the points are governed by the Shoppers Stop First Citizen programme, which can change its terms.

EazyDiner offer (issuer page): 15% instant discount, maximum ₹500 per month, minimum order ₹2,500. The "terms and conditions" link points to Axis's generic Dining Delights T&C (PDF created 30 Jun 2023), so this card's offer wording is the page only; whether the offer is limited to a number of uses is not stated.

The page "Terms and Conditions" section still says "updated w.e.f. 20th June 2025" while the banner says the terms "have been updated w.e.f. 28th August '26"; the member T&C PDF (created 7 Aug 2026) carries no revision date. Fees, earn rates and exclusions in the page, the PDF and the MITC agree, so nothing modelled depends on it.
The T&C notes the First Citizen points are shared between Shoppers Stop and Axis (e.g. 12 + 8), credited at different times.
notes: Points have lifetime validity while the card is open and expire 365 days after closure (T&C).
Fuel surcharge waiver: 1% for ₹400-₹5,000, maximum ₹400 per statement month (T&C 8; page and MITC agree).
Interest 3.75% per month (55.55% a year), forex 3.5%, cash advance 2.5% (minimum ₹500), late fee slabs ₹500 to ₹1,300 (page and MITC).
